content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Digital paypal

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle each offer unique sets of features for digital creators looking to sell their products online. However, their availability is limited, with Stripe operating in only 46 countries out of 195 worldwide. This means that creators outside of these supported countries must look for alternative solutions that can provide the necessary infrastructure for selling digital products without these platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators in restricted countries, the lack of access to major payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal can be daunting. A PayPal account suspension, for instance, can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal, further complicating the situation. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure providers like COREMERCH offer a permanent structural alternative, allowing creators to own and control their digital commerce stacks without dependence on restricted platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The payment speed, fees, and real costs associated with each platform can vary significantly. Traditional platforms often charge substantial fees and may have slower payment processing times. In contrast, solutions that utilize cryptocurrencies, such as NOWPayments with its 0.5% fee and automatic on-chain payment verification, can offer faster and more cost-effective payment processing. This is especially beneficial for creators who need to minimize transaction costs and maximize their earnings.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives creators full control over their digital businesses.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The choice of architecture depends on the creator's specific situation and needs. For those in restricted countries or seeking more control over their digital commerce, sovereign commerce infrastructure offers a compelling alternative. By leveraging free and paid tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can build and deploy their own digital commerce stacks, ensuring sovereignty and flexibility in their online businesses.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
NOWPayments offers automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee.
